```{r}
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(effectsize)
library(partR2)
```

```{R}
clean_path <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/cleaned_dat/"
merged_path <- "/Users/mlin2/Desktop/RabLab/tasks/concurrent/data/interim/merged_dat_202604"
dat_bl <- read.csv(file.path(merged_path,"merged_by_baseline_20260418.csv"))
eoad_ids <- dat_bl %>% filter(dx == "EOAD") %>% pull(subject_label)

eoad <- read.csv(
  file.path(clean_path, "cdr_ref_long_only_eoad_90d.csv"),  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  filter(subject_label %in% eoad_ids) %>%
  mutate(
    time_yrs_tau  = day_to_baseline_tau  / 365.25,
    time_yrs_ptau = day_to_baseline_ptau / 365.25,
    time_yrs_amy  = day_to_baseline_amy  / 365.25,
    time_yrs_cdr = day_to_baseline_cdr / 365.25,
    log_ptau217 = log(ptau217)
  ) %>%
  group_by(subject_label) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
 
tau_mod <- lmer(
  desikan_suvr ~ time_yrs_tau + (1   | subject_label),
  data = eoad,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

ptau_mod <- lmer(
  log_ptau217 ~ time_yrs_ptau + (1  | subject_label),
  data = eoad,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

amy_mod <- lmer(
  centiloid_wcbl ~ time_yrs_amy + (1  | subject_label),
  data = eoad,
  REML = FALSE,
  na.action = na.omit
)

# helper, use ggpredict!
# Marginal predictions + 95% CI from fixed effects
make_pred <- function(mod, term, biomarker, n = 200) {
  pred <- ggpredict(mod, terms = sprintf("%s [n=%d]", term, n))

  as.data.frame(pred) %>%
    transmute(
      time = x,
      fit  = predicted,
      lwr  = conf.low,
      upr  = conf.high,
      biomarker = biomarker
    )
}

# get prediction
pred_ptau <- make_pred(ptau_mod, "time_yrs_ptau", "p-tau217")
pred_amy  <- make_pred(amy_mod,  "time_yrs_amy",  "Centiloid")
pred_tau  <- make_pred(tau_mod,  "time_yrs_tau",  "Tau PET")

pred_all <- bind_rows(pred_ptau, pred_amy, pred_tau) %>%
  mutate(
    biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("p-tau217", "Centiloid", "Tau PET"))
  )

# Spaghetti data
spaghetti <- eoad %>%
  transmute(
    subject_label,
    log_ptau217,
    centiloid_wcbl,
    desikan_suvr,
    time_yrs_ptau,
    time_yrs_amy,
    time_yrs_tau
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(log_ptau217, centiloid_wcbl, desikan_suvr),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = case_when(
      marker == "log_ptau217"    ~ time_yrs_ptau,
      marker == "centiloid_wcbl"  ~ time_yrs_amy,
      marker == "desikan_suvr"    ~ time_yrs_tau
    ),
    biomarker = case_when(
      marker == "log_ptau217"    ~ "p-tau217",
      marker == "centiloid_wcbl" ~ "Centiloid",
      marker == "desikan_suvr"   ~ "Tau PET"
    ),
    biomarker = factor(biomarker, levels = c("p-tau217", "Centiloid", "Tau PET"))
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(time), is.finite(value))


```


```{r}
# Colors for individual trajectories
traj_cols <- c(
  "p-tau217" = "lightblue",
  "Centiloid" = "lightgreen",
  "Tau PET" = "coral"
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = spaghetti,
    aes(x = time, y = value, group = subject_label, color = biomarker),
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_all,
    aes(x = time, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
    fill = "grey60",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_all,
    aes(x = time, y = fit),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = traj_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ biomarker, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "years from baseline",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8))
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "eoad_spaghetti_lme_trajectories.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 100
)

p <- p +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ biomarker,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = labeller(
      biomarker = c(
        "p-tau217" = "log(p-tau217)",
        "Centiloid" = "Centiloid",
        "Tau PET" = "Tau PET"
      )
    )
  )
p
```


```{r}

summary(ptau_mod)
standardize_parameters(ptau_mod)
pr2 <- partR2(
  ptau_mod,
  R2_type = "marginal",
  data = eoad,
  nboot = NULL,  # start without bootstrap,
  partvars = c(  "time_yrs_ptau")
)

pr2$R2 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```
